title: Correct traversal time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly expressed as t = (8d / cosθ₀) * sqrt(m/(2E_k)).

title: Angle range identification
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) correctly states the range -30° < θ < 30° (or equivalent in radians).

title: Correct particle ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) correctly gives the ratio N/N₀ = 50% (or 1/2).

title: Kinematics in layered fields
description: Important: The solution applies piecewise kinematics, accounting for alternating electric field directions in each layer of height d.

title: Energy-velocity relation
description: Important: The solution correctly relates initial kinetic energy E_k to initial speed (v = sqrt(2E_k/m)) for use in motion equations.

title: Horizontal motion analysis
description: Important: The solution correctly uses constant horizontal velocity (v_x = v cosθ) to find the total traversal time across length 8d.

title: Vertical displacement condition
description: Important: For part (2), the solution enforces the condition that the final vertical position upon exiting side CD is within |y| < d from the axis.

title: Trigonometric equation solving
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates solving the resulting trigonometric equation (e.g., 6cos²θ' - 8sinθ'cosθ' + 1 = 0) to find critical angles.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign of the vertical acceleration when the particle enters a layer with the electric field pointing up vs. down.

title: Misapplied boundary condition
description: Pitfall: For part (2) or (3), incorrectly applies the exit condition (e.g., assuming exit exactly at the edge instead of within distance d).
